newsitem.title: UK: Major attacks Labour plans for London.
newsitem.headline: Major attacks Labour plans for London.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major said on Friday that London was increasingly becoming the "enterprise capital of Europe" and said plans by the opposition Labour Party to set up a new all-London authority could imperil this.
Major was speaking to reporters at the top of the Canary Wharf tower, in the Docklands area of the city.

"It is quite literally staggering to see what has been done (in developing London). We have seen London increasingly becoming the enterprise capital of Europe and I believe it will remain so," he said.
But Major said this could only happen if the right policies were pursued.
"The right policies do not include a new London authority, providing more bureacrats, more politicians and more taxes," he said.
